text: Experts believe that artificial intelligence will change our world in big ways. Today we have "narrow AI," which can only do one task, like translating languages. But many companies are now working on "general AI," also called AGI. This means a machine that can think and learn like a human. Supporters say AGI could help solve serious problems, such as diseases and climate change. However, others worry about the risks. A powerful AI might take jobs, spread false information, or become hard to control. Some scientists predict AGI may arrive in 20 to 50 years, while others think it is much further away. Nobody knows for sure.
